summary.text: Jessica Martinez is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Lisa Calderon (D).
She also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024, losing to Calderon in both general elections.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Martinez advanced from the June 7, 2022 primary for Assembly District 56 and lost the November 8, 2022 general election to incumbent Lisa Calderon, 58.5 percent to 41.5 percent.
She advanced again from the March 5, 2024 primary and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Calderon, 56.7 percent to 43.3 percent.
Martinez advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary alongside Calderon.
